verdict.rationale: Unit is positioned as an API-first platform. Its docs say companies can build directly on it using APIs (unit-docs-11) and that both the Dashboard and the APIs expose customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance and operational data (unit-docs-5), with webhook events documented as well (unit-docs-25). However, nothing explicitly confirms that every Dashboard action has an API equivalent, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec (unit-probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, coverage of Dashboard-only operational and admin actions via the API, a machine-readable API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
